reconstructed_theorem_text: Let Omega be a measurable space with measure mu and filtration F, and B a scalar Brownian motion with F. Here this means centered Gaussian finite-dimensional laws with covariance min(s,t), mu-almost surely continuous paths, strong F-adaptedness, and independence of B(t)-B(s) from F_s for s<=t. Let n in N, let times t_0,...,t_n in NNReal be nondecreasing, and let w_i:Omega->R for i=0,...,n-1 be strongly F_{t_i}-measurable and in L2(mu). Define D_i(omega)=(B(t_{i+1},omega)-B(t_i,omega))^2-(t_{i+1}-t_i), and E(omega)=sum_i w_i(omega)*D_i(omega). Then E belongs to L2(mu), and integral E^2 dmu = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} (integral w_i^2 dmu)*2*(t_{i+1}-t_i)^2. Differences of NNReal times are cast to R; monotonicity makes them the usual nonnegative differences. No strict grid monotonicity, initial-time-zero, fixed horizon, or usual-conditions assumption is made.
objects: Omega,mu,F,scalar Brownian B, n,nondecreasing time grid t_i, left-endpoint measurable L2 weights w_i, centered squared increments D_i, weighted sum E.
domains: Grid NNReal; n arbitrary natural including zero; real weights and Brownian motion.
quantifiers: For every scalar Brownian-with-filtration B, every finite nondecreasing grid and every family of left-endpoint strongly measurable L2 weights, both conclusions hold.
assumptions: Scalar Brownian-with-filtration property; monotone grid; each w_i strongly F_{t_i}-measurable and MemLp 2 mu. No separate finite-measure assumption.
conclusion: E in L2(mu) and the exact displayed second-moment sum formula with coefficient 2.
scopes: Finite-grid exact identity and integrability; repeated times and empty grid are allowed; no limit statement.
constant_dependencies: Universal coefficient 2; terms depend on each weight second moment and its grid-cell duration, with no existential bound.
